notes.title: New Update: Moans & Breathing Sounds Added to animations.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473327/6cb26623a1dd462f26a0f5cd4d916889085b2a46.jpg
Hey everyone!

I’ve just rolled out a spicy new update that brings the game’s animations to life with hot sounds and SFX.

 Here’s what’s new:

Moans, gasps, sighs, and hot SFX added to animations
Simple bugfixes to improve stability
Fixed some translation typos

Until now, our animations were silent... but not anymore. This update adds moans, breathing, and hot SFX to animations. Making the experience deeper, hotter, and more alive than ever.

Jump back in and enjoy this new layer of intimacy.
